**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

Section 24 satisfies the ASSIGN rule at the preferred position:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A/asset-sale successor without Vendor consent (notice only).
- **24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are consent-based with a reasonableness standard, symmetric.
- **24.4** — Expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, fee-acceleration or service-reduction right on our change of control.

No conflicting triggers elsewhere: §9 termination is limited to insolvency events, and §13 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment.
